title: KubeVirt Helm Chart Values
description: Configuration values for the KubeVirt ecosystem Helm chart (without HCO).

global.title: Global Settings
global.description: Global settings automatically propagated to all subcharts by Helm.

imageRegistry.title: Image Registry
imageRegistry.description: Optional override for the container image registry used by all subcharts.

imagePullSecrets.title: Image Pull Secrets
imagePullSecrets.description: List of image pull secret names to use across all subcharts.

nodeSelector.title: Node Selector
nodeSelector.description: Key-value pairs for node selection constraints applied to all subcharts.

tolerations.title: Tolerations
tolerations.description: List of toleration objects applied to all subchart workloads.

value.title: Value
value.description: The taint value to match (used with Equal operator).

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: The taint effect to match (NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule, NoExecute).

tolerationSeconds.title: Toleration Seconds
tolerationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds the pod tolerates the taint (NoExecute only).

kubevirtNamespace.title: KubeVirt Namespace
kubevirtNamespace.description: Namespace where KubeVirt core components are deployed. Used by kubevirt, vm-console-proxy, and monitoring subcharts.

kubevirt.title: KubeVirt Core
kubevirt.description: KubeVirt core operator and runtime. Always deployed (no condition toggle).

cdi.title: CDI
cdi.description: Containerized Data Importer for importing VM disk images.

enabled.title: Enable CDI
enabled.description: Deploy the Containerized Data Importer subchart.

multus.title: Multus CNI
multus.description: Multus CNI for attaching multiple network interfaces to pods and VMs.

kubemacpool.title: KubeMacPool
kubemacpool.description: MAC address pool manager for KubeVirt virtual machines.

aaq.title: AAQ
aaq.description: Application Aware Quota for KubeVirt-aware resource quota management.

enabled.title: Enable AAQ
enabled.description: Deploy the Application Aware Quota subchart.

butane-operator.title: Butane Operator
butane-operator.description: Operator for managing Butane/Ignition configurations for VMs.

vm-console-proxy.title: VM Console Proxy
vm-console-proxy.description: Proxy for accessing KubeVirt VM consoles.

enabled.title: Enable VM Console Proxy
enabled.description: Deploy the VM Console Proxy subchart.

hostpath-provisioner.title: HostPath Provisioner
hostpath-provisioner.description: HostPath-based storage provisioner for dev/test environments. Requires cert-manager.

enabled.title: Enable HostPath Provisioner
enabled.description: Deploy the HostPath Provisioner subchart (dev/test only).

forklift.title: Forklift
forklift.description: VM migration toolkit for migrating VMs from other platforms to KubeVirt.

enabled.title: Enable Forklift
enabled.description: Deploy the Forklift VM migration subchart.

cloud-provider-kubevirt.title: Cloud Provider KubeVirt
cloud-provider-kubevirt.description: Kubernetes cloud provider implementation for KubeVirt.

enabled.title: Enable Cloud Provider KubeVirt
enabled.description: Deploy the Cloud Provider KubeVirt subchart.

ipam-controller.title: IPAM Controller
ipam-controller.description: IP address management controller for persistent VM IPs. Requires cert-manager.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: ServiceMonitor and PrometheusRules for KubeVirt observability. Requires kube-prometheus-stack.

enabled.title: Enable Monitoring
enabled.description: Deploy the monitoring subchart (ServiceMonitor and PrometheusRules).

delete-protection.title: Delete Protection
delete-protection.description: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy to prevent accidental deletion of VMs.

enabled.title: Enable Delete Protection
enabled.description: Deploy the delete protection ValidatingAdmissionPolicy subchart.

vm-templates.title: VM Templates
vm-templates.description: Native KubeVirt 1.8 VirtualMachineTemplate resources. Requires KubeVirt CRDs to be present.

enabled.title: Enable VM Templates
enabled.description: Deploy the VM Templates subchart (enable after initial install).

kubevirt-stack-crds.title: CRD Management (alias)
kubevirt-stack-crds.description: Helm dependency alias for CRD subchart.
